subject: Renewal QBR — targeted 90min demo, stack owners & recording approach
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR — targeted 90min demo, stack owners & recording approach

Hi Jordan / Alicia,

Thanks for confirming the renewal window — we hear you on the exec constraints. To make the QBR high-impact given the 90-minute limit, I propose:

- 15 min: concise renewal status + contract next steps (Marissa)
- 45 min: focused roadmap demo showing the features you asked about (Vivek)
- 20 min: technical deep-dive / ops runbook Q&A (Rishi)
- 10 min: clear next steps and decision checklist

Please confirm whether the above split would cover the stakeholders you plan to bring. If execs only join the first 25 minutes, we can record the roadmap demo and provide time-stamped clips for their review. We also have a short ops runbook (attached) we can pre-share.

Proposed times (PT):
- Option A: Thu Jun 8, 10:00–11:30
- Option B: Fri Jun 9, 13:00–14:30

I attached the current QBR deck and an availability grid. If those slots don't work, propose two alternatives and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: redwood-qbr-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 18 pages), availability-grid.ics (calendar file)
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@luminahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Chen <alicia@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — targeted 90min demo, stack owners & recording approach

Naomi,

Appreciate the structure — that looks sensible. Execs can do the first 25 minutes on Jun 8 at 10:00 PT, but they need the roadmap highlights up front. Can your team surface the two top roadmap items (model routing cost controls and dedicated inference SLA changes) in the first 10 minutes of the demo?

Also, we require the session to be recorded and the recording to be shared internally. Will you be able to produce a short clip (2–3 min) of the roadmap highlights for our execs?

One ask on attendees: our infra lead wants to cover data residency briefly and may join for the technical section — I’ll add Alicia for coordination.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Director, Data Platforms | LuminaHealth
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Alicia Chen <alicia@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — targeted 90min demo, stack owners & recording approach

Jordan / Alicia,

Perfect — we’ll lock Jun 8 10:00–11:30 PT and make sure the first 10 minutes are the roadmap highlights you asked for (model routing cost controls + SLA improvements).

Operational notes:
- Vivek will demo the roadmap items and produce a 3-minute highlight clip immediately after the session.
- Rishi will join the technical section to cover data residency, KV cache behavior, and the Dedicated tier isolation guarantees.
- Marissa will run the renewal checklist and record agreed next steps live in the doc so you can sign off quickly.

I attached the ops runbook with the two technical slides Alicia flagged. Rishi — can you confirm you’re able to cover the residency bullets and take a quick look at the runbook?

Marissa — will you own the DocuSign envelope and a short follow-up one-pager for the execs? If you can prepare the 1-page renewal checklist before the call, that will help speed the decision.

Thanks all — locking calendar now and will circulate the invite with dial-in + recording permissions.

Best,
Naomi

Attachments: ops-runbook.xlsx (Excel, ops steps and owner matrix)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@luminahealth.com>, Alicia Chen <alicia@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — targeted 90min demo, stack owners & recording approach

Thanks Naomi — I’ll cover data residency and the specific isolation language for Dedicated. Quick notes for the agenda so we don’t run over:

- I’ll prepare two slides: (1) residency + encryption at rest and in transit, (2) KV cache and fallback behavior under high-throughput scenarios.
- If time is tight, we can surface the detailed runbook as pre-read; I’ll highlight three potential customer questions and one minute-by-minute fallback script.
- I’ll also join the recording handoff and ensure we capture the 3-minute roadmap highlight.

See you all on Jun 8.

Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
